text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out shopping...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Decisions, decisions! Which one
should I
get?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Should I get the limited-edition Flavor
Explosion
Chips?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Or should I grab the Sweetie Pie
Chocolate Bar
that I already know I
love?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, it's impossible to pick! Which
snack am I
supposed to eat after school
today?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think I should
choose?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right?! What's even the point if I'm not
doing
something exciting?! ♪ I'm not
great with spice,
but I gotta at least try!
choice_data_list_en: Sticking to the classics is best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's method of choosing
snacks
might be a good approach to
running too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah, I get you. Gotta stick with what
you
know when it comes to snacks.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's such a bummer when you try

something new and it sucks! Okay, then
this one it
is!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm, hmmm! ♪ I can't wait for school
to be
over! ♪

text_block_list.text:

snacks
might be a good approach to
running too.
